gate: Jev FiQA rerank ECE 0.3109 -> <= 0.10 on held-out
method_note: The baseline retained 10 binned aggregates (n_pairs=19440), not the raw pairs; pairs are reconstructed per bin at mean_conf with positives = round(acc*n), and the held-out split is at BIN granularity: fit on even bins, evaluate on odd bins (whole probability regions the fit never saw). The pair-level held-out re-run needs the model's raw scores and is the rc.80 final form.
